description:
Data-driven estimate using reference class forecasting.

Applies historical correction factors based on actual-vs-estimated ratios.
When no historical data exists, uses industry averages (1.3-2.2x for software tasks).
Prioritize this over algorithmic models when historical data is available.

ai_native.description: Degree of AI assistance: 0.0 = fully human, 1.0 = fully AI-native, 0.5 = hybrid. Accepts boolean for backward compatibility (true=1.0, false=0.0).

complexity.description: Fine-tuning complexity from 1 (trivial) to 5 (extreme). Adjusts within the scope band: low complexity shortens, high complexity lengthens the estimate.

project.description: Optional project/repo identifier this estimate belongs to, for cross-project analytics.

scope.description: Rough size of the task: small=tiny fix/tweak, medium=typical task, large=significant effort, xl=epic-scale. When omitted, inferred from complexity (1-2=small, 3=medium, 4=large, 5=xl).

session_id.description: Optional session identifier (minted by a calling agent/hook) used to deduplicate repeated estimate calls for the same task within a session.

task_label.description: Optional free-text label identifying the task this estimate is for (e.g. an issue key or short title). Surfaced on get_pending_estimates output for triage.

task_type.description: Category of work being estimated for reference-class lookup.

team_id.description: Optional team identifier to scope historical data to a specific team.

name: reference_class_estimate
